title: Location can be a relative reference and should be resolved relative to the current request URI
summary: When reconstructing a redirect chain, resolve each Location against the request URI that produced that response.
applies: Offline HTTP transactions and partial response logging
detail: The same ../done will be resolved to different locations when returned by /a/b/start and /x/start. Successful responses to other requests do not automatically belong to this chain.
boundary: Location describes the suggested jump location; whether it actually follows needs to be proven by the next request record.
relevance: Attribute multiple interleaved jumps and their receipts in HAR to the correct requests respectively.
